_doc: Material-class signatures measured over 40 object sprites each (tools/: signature = p10-p90 value spread, median saturation, median local value gradient, p90 gradient (hard-edge share), median 12px window tones).

foliage._measured_on: vanilla farming crops at fullGrown: BellPepper, Tomato, Cabbages, Barley, Corn, SweetPotato, Greenpeas (green-hue pixels only); tools: scratch sig_foliage.py with the definition in _doc

soil._measured_on: the tilled bed of the same sprites plus the bare beds vegetation_farming_01b_64 and _01b_0 (brown-hue pixels below row 150)
